_doc_note: Same request shape as perplexity_agent_searched.json, per https://docs.perplexity.ai/api-reference/agent-post and https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/agent-api/tools/web-search, read 2026-10-05. The docs show no response in which the model chose not to search, and say only that usage carries tool_calls_details.search_web.invocation when tool-call usage is reported. This fixture assumes an explicit zero invocation count and no search_results item; a response with neither a count nor a search_results item parses as activated unknown.
